values.note: Campground Rates 2026: no hook-up $35/night ($245/week), water and electric $40 ($266/week, $750/month), water, electric and sewer $45 ($300/week, $920/month), for 2 adults and 2 children. Overnight guests over 5 $10/night; early check-in $20.

fees.source: https://www.skybrookcampground.com/rates ('Campground Rates 2026'; 'No Hook Up Nightly Rate $35', 'Water and Electric Nightly Rate $40', 'Water, Electic and Sewer Nightly Rate $45'), read 2026-10-21 in a browser

hookups.source: https://www.skybrookcampground.com/ ('over 350 sites with water and electric ... limited to 30 and 20 amp service') + https://www.skybrookcampground.com/rates ('Water, Electic and Sewer' sites; 'The majority of our full-hookup sites are currently reserved by seasonal campers'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.skybrookcampground.com/ ('4 newly remodeled bathhouses with FREE showers, a coin laundry facility and a camp store') + https://www.skybrookcampground.com/rates ('have three dump stations'), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://www.skybrookcampground.com/rates and /park-policies (no military discount named on the operator's pages; the value came from the Good Sam directory), read 2026-10-21

note: Dansville (off I-390), 255 acres of rolling country with small ponds (rowboats on the duck pond, a catch-and-release fish pond). 350+ water/electric sites; the majority of full-hookup sites are held by seasonal campers, and a seasonal reservation takes priority over a weekend site unless within 14 days of a holiday weekend. Weekend-activity oriented (bands, hayrides), ~May-Oct. --Claude
summary: Confirmed the 2026 rates ($35 no hook-up, $40 W/E, $45 full hookup; weekly/monthly too), 30-amp max with water and sewer, showers, coin laundry, camp store, three dump stations. Cleared the Good Sam directory's military discount (not on the operator's pages). Note trimmed of field facts. Long-stay test passes on the pages: nightly and weekly rates posted with no minimum, no application; seasonals hold most full-hookup sites but 350+ sites in all. Not stated: season dates, site count beyond 'over 350', pull-throughs, booking channel beyond phone.
